crossRefs.note: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor the brook of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring…
Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you to go on the way to Assyria…
Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed…
Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of…
When your wares went out of the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude…
by your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your…
Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,
The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

people.name: Nile
people.line: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts

translations.web: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.
translations.bsb: On the great waters came the grain of Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre; she was the merchant of the nations.
translations.kjv: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
translations.asv: And on great waters the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; and she was the mart of nations.
